title: FLA: saveRealFla silently drops many modeled fields the importer reads (filters, color effects, gradient/bitmap fills, custom ease, mask/parent, guides)
description: packages/core/src/fla/write/timeline-write.ts (real-FLA writer) discards fields the importer fully decodes — same data-loss class as the fixed frame-sound case (task 1205): (a) filters always filterCount=0 (:726 instances, :840 bitmap, :897-898 text) although importer decodes them (readCPicSymbolFields:2218-2239). (b) color effects: only type 'alpha' encoded (:767-784 colorEffectChannels), brightness/tint/advanced fall back to identity; importer decodes full CXFORM (:2188-2209). (c) shape fills: gradients written as first-stop solid, bitmap fills as solid white (writeFillStyle:574-595); reader supports both (readFillStyle focal/spread/stops). (d) custom per-property motion ease: useSingleEaseCurve=1/hasCustomEase=0 always (:308-309); importer decodes the F8 ease table into motionEaseCurve + per-property curves (flash8-binary.ts:2999-3055). (e) layer parent/mask: parentReference=0 always (:185-187), masked->0 (LAYER_TYPE_BYTE:150) with no back-link; importer reconstructs masks/folders (resolveMaskedLayers). (f) document guides never written (PAGE_TAIL guideCount=0) and shape-tween morph geometry morphTag always 0 (:286). Also low: envelope level clamp mismatch (writer max 32768 :370-372 vs reader u16 :2926-2927); scene-vs-symbol FixedPageTail reuse may be spec-inaccurate (contents-write.ts:188-214 vs docs/21 §8.3). Fix: emit the inverse wire forms per docs/21 for each field; add round-trip tests. Confidence: confirmed (each field read by importer, dropped by writer).
